name: Bark Galleries
desc: Engraved under the bark — a mother gallery runs the grain laying egg niches while larval tunnels fan off perpendicular, widening as the larvae grow and never once crossing each other's path, ending in pupal chambers; then the brood emerges, the galleries weather away and a new colony attacks.

density.doc: number of colonies, brood spacing and surface grime

speed.doc: rate multiplier on growth and process time

axis.doc: mother-gallery orientation: 0 runs with the grain, 1 across it
